entry.title: HexChord 73 1.0.1
entry.summary: Updated the MPC wrapper, display refresh and installation scripts. Q-Links in Screen mode now follow the PERFORM, SYNTH and CHORD pages. Verified on MPC Live II Retro / OS 3.10: native controls and automation, preset/project recall, installation, removal and user-file preservation. CPU benchmark: WARN — p99 22.5%, maximum block 23.0%. CPU verdict WARN: start with one or two instances and check the MPC project CPU meter.

entry.title: HexChord 73 1.0.0
entry.summary: HexChord 73: stereo chord synthesizer with four engines, eight chords and four voicings. Tested on MPC Live 2 Retro / Gen1 / MPC OS 3.9.1 and 3.10. CPU: **WARN** — start with one or two instances and check the project CPU meter. [Installation and controls](https://github.com/Eurikon/mpc-vst-plugins/blob/main/Instruments/HexaChord-73/README.md).
